meanings.experience: one provider-neutral scene graph carries each scene semantic focus, viewpoint, camera intent, overlay, narration authority, and evidence reference, and any semantic focus absent from admitted authority is rejected with an attributable fidelity finding

meanings.responsibility: the exact topology, routes, labels, and evidence visuals are rendered

meanings.responsibility: permitted creative media are generated within the declared scene intent

one attributable narration asset binds every spoken assertion to the admitted authority or evidence reference that grounds it, and an assertion without such a reference is returned as an exact grounding finding

meanings.responsibility: the cognitive video projection is assembled

meanings.experience: exactly one candidate video is produced from the complete production set, and a missing, duplicated, stale, or digest-divergent production branch holds assembly without producing a candidate

findings.subject: reveal-and-refine-capability-meaning
findings.detail: The separate canonical blueprint is retained exactly, including topology, semantic progress and observability. It is not conflated with the runtime graph.
findings.closure: Qualify a visual profile for the blueprint carrier before projecting its state and responsibility nodes as execution flow.

findings.subject: reveal-and-refine-capability-meaning
findings.detail: Source revelation preserves declarations; human storytelling and visual acceptance are separate.
findings.closure: Review the scenario, claim scope, evidence, human experience and selected animation trace before episode use.

findings.subject: reveal-and-refine-capability-meaning
findings.detail: Native records are preserved and inspectable. Scenario triads are not a simulation of the native execution graph.
findings.closure: Admit explicit visual/trace profiles for native control flow before animating its mechanics.

findings.subject: reveal-and-refine-capability-meaning
findings.detail: Legacy plan operations and bindings are retained exactly; no full canonical graph is supplied.
